notes.title: Huge update!
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

I am super excited to finally announce the big update I've been working on since January. It is almost 100 days of work (most of you know, I worked on this practically every day of the week)! If you have not been playing the Testing branch, this is going to be an excellent surprise for you 💦💦💦

First things first, thank you to everyone who joined Discord and took the time to report issues, give ideas, and talk with me about what they had in mind in general. It makes a huge difference in the game, and that means so much to me!

Quick summary?
60+ New content
300+ Improvements & fixes
(All of that is only possible because people keep joining  Discord  and report me issues and suggest new content)

Here what is new for the 0.90:(bug fixes and improvements at the end)

Highlight news!

New voice for all characters! Stepmom, Stepsister, Main Character!

Hard to picture this right ahah, but the Voice Actor and Voice Actress did an incredible job! They are super reliable and will continue to work with us for future chapters and projects 🥰

Progression with Stepmom!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982264/6fbaea0c0159514f23e7ef1210d84e1079e5cd3d.png
Stepmom has now progressed to unlock in 6 chapters. From asking her to follow you, doing laundry to distract her, to kisses and more! As some of you know, the next chapter will be fully dedicated to her and will have more progression to unlock.

Progression also means that all chapters affected by this now have dialogue options that give more content and opportunity to replay and have a different ending for the chapter in question.

Steam Workshop for Girl Creator!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982264/cecb06fd6e6c6d8752a7432917058940f98759c6.png
Here it is! People have shared over 250+ girls, and I am sure it will go over 1000 quite fast. Thank you for being creative and pushing the limit!

Task system!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982264/06b75109d47c2c7f6cfc865aac23798e2ff560c1.png
The task system will be the core of the Life Cycle. Right now, it has been used a lot to replace more complex steps in the chapter. It essentially allow me to create more action without having to enter as much data, but also will make it more easy to translate these from any chapter directly to the Life Cycle!

The Life Cycle will be my main focus after the next chapter (which the next chapter will be my main focus after this Major Update.

Bunch of new sex animations!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982264/de93adb935608a5989e60fe8dab7d1a4f73b4aa5.png
Sex on the pool table, in the shower, in the pool, on the couch, on the kitchen counter, and more to come shortly.

New genitals for male and female!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982264/8f2545e181b467495d0af630a21416f1dde19b3e.png
New genital is quite good, it required a bit more work and will need some clothes to be adjusted to be better. The benefit is not only them looking nicer, but it also support much better the realistic cumming feature. Also, now you have a bunch of parameters to modify and the male genital, and a limited amount for the girl.

First iteration for realistic cum system!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982264/b07536ae1c56df0d6c7e9a46b772e0ae31fa7a48.png
Realistic cum is not finish! But this is the first stable version, and it will be improved in the following months, but it is much, much better than the old particle I had. Now they are acting like clothes, but in a dynamic way. They get reset between chapters, but no way to remove them yet. I will add a "rag" shortly to clean them.

More interactive content!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982264/0de585aca8c64a20659cbd180ed281ed5663e0e4.png
The interactive content has been improving, and like usual, I am trying to bind them to the chapter, but it can also be done without playing the chapter. The whole goal is to make them part of the Life Cycle as I get there.

New Seasonal event!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982264/6737f15e13246b1f7c4df56a09fd9eb70e914adb.png
It was supposed to be for last month, but I had so much work to do, that it got delayed a little bit and has been a bit more exclusive for the pioneer who dares to play the Testing Branch (which is available to everyone!)

First iteration character creator for male!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982264/61c7327db9155696ad15127125b1506f00f9abc3.png
This also includes the first iteration for the male creator! It doesn't have all the shapes, and it is still missing the clothes option. But it is quite decent at the moment. It is not yet compatible with the Steam Workshop.
